title: Broker’s Call: ICICI Lombard General Insurance (Add) - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
The management sees these reforms as a long-term positive for multi-product, multi-channel insurers like ICICIGI

‘We attended ICICI Lombard’s ‘Digital Day 2026’, where the senior management showcased the company’s proprietary digital stack, cloud native digital architecture and AI-led operating flywheel. The transition — from viewing technology as a supportive back-office function to positioning it at the forefront of business generation — along with risk selection has enhanced operational agility and cost structures. ICICIGI’s fully in-house technology stack now powers a digital flywheel across distribution, product, risk, claims servicing and retention.

The regulatory recalibration of distribution economics, as led by IRDAI’s proposed commission caps and tighter EoM limits, is set to trigger a structural reset across the industry. By eliminating aggressive commission-led distribution, the reforms transition the intermediary landscape to an environment where brand equity, digital execution and claims servicing reliability dominate the shelf space.

The management sees these reforms as a long-term positive for multi-product, multi-channel insurers like ICICIGI. While pricing can be commoditised, operational scale and servicing efficiency will emerge as primary competitive moats. By FY29, ICICIGI targets achieving 100-200bps growth alpha vs the industry, digital sourcing share of 15 per cent, a sustained 10ppt + CoR advantage over the industry, and 17-20 per cent ROE.

We reiterate ADD on the stock and retain September 2027E TP of ₹1,900.
